text:
Salutations cargo team,
Steady rush so far, and the lounge attendant reviewed some notes on farewell routines

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk process calm and consistent from booking through pickup. Each case should be checked for the animal's comfort, the traveler's documents, and any care notes that may affect handling. When a pet is moving through our system, the senior coordinator should confirm that humane methods are used and that the welcome team is ready to support boarding without creating extra stress.

If any form appears incomplete, or if a carrier instruction seems unclear, record the concern at once and pass it to the proper desk channel. Clear communication helps Aurelia Skyways protect both service quality and animal welfare. Remind travelers in a formal, steady tone that preparation makes the journey easier for everyone involved.

Please continue to work carefully, maintain orderly records, and share only verified updates with the rest of the team. Consistent attention to detail keeps our department dependable for every arrival and departure.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
